newsitem.title: USA: PictureTel, Nippon Telegraph in venture.
newsitem.headline: PictureTel, Nippon Telegraph in venture.

text.p: Videoconferencing firm PictureTel Corp on Tuesday said it and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp have estabished a joint venture specializing in providing multipoint videoconferencing services in Japan.

The joint venture, called NTT Phoenix Communications Network Inc, will provide the services using the NTT PCN multipoint videoconferencing network center, which initially can manage up to 1,000 videoconferencing sites simultaneously.
NTT will own about 44 percent of the company while PictureTel will own about 20 percent, PictureTel said.
Two of PictureTel's major distributors in Japan, certain NTT subsidiaries, and NOVA, a private nationwide foreign language school in Japan, are minority investors in the joint venture.
NTT Phoenix Communications Network will have its headquarters in Tokyo. Board members and the management team will include representatives from both PictureTel and NTT.
